description: Schedules draft pins (image URLs from generate_pins or list_drafts) to Pinterest, spaced out over time. Give board_id to put them all on one board, or leave it out and each pin goes to the board that fits it best (sure matches only). When some pins fit none of the boards, one new board is created for them on Pinterest, named after what they are about (the same as URL2Pin Autopilot does; set new_board_if_none to false to stop that). Pins that still fit nothing stay as drafts and are listed. The first pin goes out at start_at, the next one hours_between later, and so on. Pins are only scheduled, never posted instantly, and can be cancelled with cancel_scheduled or in the app until they go out. Up to 20 pins per call. Confirm the times (and the board, if the person named one) with the person before calling this.

account_id.description: Which connected Pinterest account. Only needed with more than one.

board_id.description: From list_boards. Leave out to pick the best board for each pin automatically.

hours_between.description: Hours between pins. Default 24 (one a day).

image_urls.description: Image URLs of draft pins, in the order they should go out.

new_board_if_none.description: Without board_id: create one new board for pins that fit no existing board. Default true.

start_at.description: When the first pin goes out, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-11-20T18:00:00-05:00. Must be at least 10 minutes from now.

name: schedule_pins
title: Schedule pins to Pinterest
